title: 15 Craziest World Records
description:
Subscribe ► http://goo.gl/WPKt5w

Today's issue will make your heart beat faster because we have prepared for you 15 most crazy and unusual records. There will be fire, dizzy heights, and crazy depths. If you want to know how many minutes a person can survive in a bulb filled with ice or in fire without oxygen, what it's like to be tied to a reactive dragster and make a crazy trip hearing only the roar of his motor, or if you want to feel the drive of a rider racing with the speed of a passenger liner, then make yourself comfortable and let’s go!

For all questions contact us at: amazingstockchannel@gmail.com
author: Amazing Stock
